text:
## Purpose  
Implement enhanced-KYC requirements from 2026-03-01. This procedure supersedes
Version 2.1 in full from that date.

raw_entities.description: A comprehensive Know Your Customer procedure implementing enhanced KYC requirements effective from 2026-03-01. This procedure supersedes the previous Version 2.1 in full, establishing new identity and address verification standards for customer onboarding and ongoing compliance.
